segments.title: 01 / Start with the original document
segments.caption: An original 10-page BEA release: charts, notes, and statistical tables. Source linked in the app.

segments.title: 02 / Define categories in plain language
segments.caption: Review editable category descriptions and document-level instructions. The whole document informs one decision.

segments.title: 03 / Choose the OCR layer
segments.caption: LiteParse runs locally by default. LlamaParse offers Cost-effective, Agentic, and Agentic Plus modes.

segments.title: 04 / Read, then classify
segments.caption: Actual processing, shown at normal speed: LiteParse reads all 10 pages, then Jev applies the rules.

segments.title: 05 / Inspect the decision and timings
segments.caption: Press Release. Jev: 326 ms. Reading: 4.34 s. Full pipeline: 4.76 s for this run.

segments.title: 06 / Inspect the source pages
segments.caption: Browse the original pages alongside the result and category probabilities. Structured JSON is available.

segments.title: 07 / Compare measured decision speed
segments.caption: Saved pilot: Jev 182 ms vs. GPT-5.6 Luna 785 ms median. One source, three timed runs per model.

segments.title: 08 / Try another document
segments.caption: A Treasury auction report uses the same rules and OCR path. This second run is also shown at normal speed.

segments.title: 09 / Reuse the workflow
segments.caption: Financial Report. Jev: 312 ms. Full pipeline: 875 ms. Timings are measured for this one-page report.

notes: Raw video is trimmed; every retained recording segment is speed 1. Actual cursor pixels are preserved. At most a few terminal frames repeat solely for frame-rate rounding.

quality_checks.motion_inspection: Quarter-second ordered frame sequences inspected across both processing intervals and page navigation.
limitations: The Treasury large result card is above the captured viewport; its Financial Report probability label and timings remain visible.
quality_checks.caption_revision: Category rules described as reviewed rather than changed, matching the captured interaction.

input_visibility: Local unpublished provenance; raw captures are not shipped in the repository.
